100-park-554186.address: 170 Century Square Dr, College Station, TX 77840, United States
100-park-554186.name: 100 Park

reviews.author: Kit Kamisato
reviews.content: I have visited my friend many times at this apartment and honestly I don't know why they even live here. Getting in and out of the apartment is a headache from 3pm-7pm on most days. Car gate is broken about 80% of the time, I can easily walk in if I park in Century Square garage since the gates are always open, and anything that isn't the office is pretty dirty. Also I feel like there are way more people moving out the apartment than moving in based on how many U-Hauls I have seen throughout the year. Please do yourself a favor and live somewhere else that is just as close, just as nice, and cost less

reviews.author: Eric Shah

The lobby is always exceptionally clean due to Veronica's hard work. John is extremely responsive with maintenance and is one of the kindest guys I know. The property manager, Elena, really knows how to bring a sense of community with her welcoming vibes. We canât forget how welcoming and caring the front staff are, either. I highly recommend 100PARK for your College Station endeavors!

reviews.author: Travis Gilmore
reviews.content: Great place and great service. John is always extremely helpful when I need his assistance.

100-park-554186.reviews_summary: This property offers a prime location within walking distance of campus, dining, and entertainment, with many residents appreciating the spacious apartments, helpful staff, and various amenities like a gym and pool. However, some students have experienced persistent issues with noise, cleanliness, and frequently broken gates, leading to concerns about security and value for money.

12-north.address: 301 Church Ave, College Station, TX 77840, United States
12-north.name: 12 North
12-north.property_summary: 12 North is a student housing property located at 301 Church Ave in College Station, TX, offering fully furnished apartments just one block from Texas A&M University and within walking distance of the Northgate Entertainment District. reviews.author: Jennifer Finegan

reviews.author: Jessica C

The pool area is lovely, and the gym was clean and well-organized. The staff was also great. Neha gave me a quick tour and was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic, which made the experience even better. Overall, the community has a very positive and comfortable atmosphere. Highly recommend :)

12-north.reviews_summary: This community offers a positive and comfortable atmosphere, with spacious and clean apartments, lovely amenities like the pool and gym, and a convenient location close to campus and social hubs. However, prospective residents should be aware of recurring issues with visitor parking signage leading to towing, frequent fire alarms, and occasional internet outages.

1711-caroline-f21b95.address: 1711 Caroline St, Houston, TX 77002, United States
1711-caroline-f21b95.name: 1711 Caroline
1711-caroline-f21b95.property_summary: 1711 Caroline is a pet-friendly apartment community located in the Central Business District of downtown Houston, offering studio, one, and two-bedroom units. It is conveniently situated within walking distance of dining, entertainment, and major employers, with easy access to the Metrorail, and is near Houston Community College, the University of Houston, and the University of St. Thomas. The property boasts luxury amenities including a swimming pool, a 24-hour fitness studio, a rooftop terrace with city views, and a clubhouse with a billiards lounge.

reviews.author: Pamela Lewis
reviews.content:
I would like to offer some constructive feedback regarding my moveâin experience. The process felt extremely rushed, as there was only one person assisting multiple residents on Saturday. This was unfair to both Veronica and to me as a new resident who is paying to move into your community. Because everything was so hurried, I am not confident that all necessary information was fully explained during the lease signing and key handoff.

Additionally, I am disappointed to discover that my apartment faces a dump site. I had no opportunity to request a different unit because the staff member was overwhelmed with the volume of moveâins.

reviews.author: Metoya Scott
reviews.content:
For anyone considering leasing here, I recommend asking detailed questions about the parking enforcement process before signing.

Multiple residents, including guests of residents, have experienced repeated towing incidents within very short timeframes after parking or uncommunicated violations within the garage. In some cases vehicles were registered or attempting to be registered with a minor error and residents were still charged over $300 per tow.

This level of scrutiny does not align with what I would expect of a luxury downtown mid-rise.

The parking system also does not allow renewal before expiration, which can leave vehicles temporarily unregistered despite attempts to comply.

Please make sure you fully understand the parking rules and enforcement practices before deciding to lease.

reviews.author: My LightWarrior
reviews.content:
James Bishop was amazing during my tour at 1711 Caroline Apartments. I called to ask about availability and asked about getting a guided tour.  He showed me both a two bedroom and a one bedroom option and explained everything clearly without rushing me.

The community itself was very clean and quiet, and I felt comfortable walking around the property. The apartments were beautiful and well maintained. This property is definitely at the top of my list and I am planning on applying soon. Thank you James for such great customer service!

reviews.author: Freckled Cajun 504
reviews.content: Greg and his team did one heck of an amazing job, making sure that I was comfortable through my whole rental process. They were professional. 1711-caroline-f21b95.reviews_summary: Students consistently praise this property for its quiet and clean environment, with many appreciating the well-maintained apartments and convenient downtown location offering great views. 1810-main-apartments-wjo43k.name: 1810 Main Apartments

2016-main-condominiums-pj1628.name: 2016 Main Condominiums
2016-main-condominiums-pj1628.property_summary: 2016 Main Condominiums is a 26-story high-rise residential building located in Houston's Midtown neighborhood, offering studio to five-bedroom units. It is conveniently located near several universities, including Houston Community College (1.4 miles), University of St. Thomas (1.8 miles), and University of Houston-Downtown (1.9 miles). reviews.author: Emily Leng

The elevator has been broken for nearly four years. This is unacceptable and creates serious inconvenience and safety concerns for residents. Instead of fixing the actual problem, management continues to perform cosmetic work such as repainting the walls repeatedly, while the elevator remains unusable.

At the same time, HOA fees continue to increase dramatically. Residents are paying more and more each year, yet the quality of services and maintenance is getting worse.

Additionally, the building Wi-Fi is extremely slow and frequently does not work properly. This has been an ongoing problem that has not been resolved.

Residents deserve transparency and proper maintenance for the fees we are paying. Immediate action is needed to repair the elevator permanently, address the Wi-Fi issues, and explain why HOA fees continue to increase while services decline.

2111-austin-apartments-7jdg8q.name: 2111 Austin Apartments
2111-austin-apartments-7jdg8q.property_summary: 2111 Austin Apartments is a pet-friendly student housing property located in Midtown, Houston, offering urban living with spacious floor plans and high-end finishes. reviews.author: Leon Brown

2222-smith-street-gfluuu.reviews_summary: Many students appreciate the spacious rooms, responsive staff, and quick maintenance, contributing to a safe, clean, and well-cared-for community. 2756-nueces-apartments-133f44.address: 2400 Nueces St, Austin, TX 78705, United States
2756-nueces-apartments-133f44.name: 2756 Nueces Apartments
2756-nueces-apartments-133f44.property_summary: 2400 Nueces Apartments is a 16-story student housing complex located in the West Campus area of Austin, Texas, just steps away from the University of Texas at Austin. Key amenities include a resort-style pool, 24-hour fitness center, rooftop patio, and all utilities included in the rent.

reviews.author: John 117
reviews.content: Good student apartments that are owned by UT, which will keep prices low, but low relative to west campus. Spots are also competitive, because they offer 9 month leases to seniors intead of the usual 12 that force you to have to sublease in summer.

reviews.author: Sana Ali

They also have the option to release your contract if you have an internship or are graduating. Overall, responsive service and good management!

reviews.author: Hannah Wesley
reviews.content: No warning email or communication when fire alarm testing is conducted. The most recent testing was conducted from 9:30 - 11am

reviews.author: Lauren C

The washers and dryers are kinda low quality, and the water takes FOREVER to get hot. The worst part is that I can only get 15 minute hot showers, and my bathroom sink pressure SUCKS. The parking is pretty expensive, and the rent and cost of Parking only seem to go up every year. I know this place is better than most, but they still have some work to do. Otherwise the staff is super friendly. Oh and I love that they're one of the only apartments that will let you break your lease for graduation/military/internships!

2756-nueces-apartments-133f44.reviews_summary: This property offers a generally positive living experience, especially appealing for its excellent proximity to campus and the convenience of having your UT ID double as your apartment key. However, some residents have noted that the elevators can be slow or occasionally out of service, and certain aspects of day-to-day living, like hot water consistency or package retrieval, could be improved.
2756-nueces-apartments-133f44.university: The University of Texas at Austin

(OR 17 or 18) I lived on the 4th floor less than 10 feet from a common area that I was not told (ever) was used for parties and at least 2 nights usually 3 or 4 a week there were massive parties that would go until 1-2+ AM that would be shaking my bed from noise. I was not warned about this before moving in, the building did nothing about it (no rent discount, nothing). Overall not worth the money. 4th floor was always trashed, other floors might have been cleaner from less people using them but it still says a lot about the quality of care they take. also at least one elevator was ALWAYS broken, i usually took the stairs to the 4th floor. only 3 working elevators maybe 4 weeks the whole year i lived here. Owner says they have noise complaint policies in place but everytime i called I got sent to an AI bot and management/building staff never did a thing, except for a single time out of over 100+ parties. Do not let this place take your money.

reviews.author: Mia Holberg
reviews.content: Lived here for 2 years. My apartment was great- working AC, running hot water, no bugs, didnât have to pay utilities. Maintenance was very friendly. BUTâ¦ if you have a car, DO NOT PARK HERE. If you ride a bike, KEEP IT IN YOUR APARTMENT. My car was broken into 3 times, and my bike was attempted to be stolen twice. Iâve gone through two heavy-duty bike locks. Ion Austin leaves the back doors on level two open 24/7. These back doors lead to an alleyway full of homeless people. They can come in and out as they please, and there is no security camera to see who comes in. Ion Austin will not pay for damages or respond to any complaints. This review is written by a girl who rarely has anything to complain about. This is really just a PSA.

reviews.content: By far the worst corporate center ever. reviews.author: Casey Kung
reviews.content: I lived here for 3 years. The management is terrible, and I truly wish that was an understatement. I had a great time living here, but there were so many issues like the 6th floor being unusable for a whole year (maybe more), leak in piping in the garage, the elevators that broke at least once a week, and basically no care for our concerns. After moving out, I was hit with a nearly $400 dollar cleanup fee, and a majority of the cost was a few small marks on the wall leading to a full bedroom repaint and a picture of a spotless carpet floor leading to an over $100 cleaning fee. I disputed my charges right after move out (in July), and I have yet to hear any news other than âwe have escalated your requests but you do not have to pay yetâ and contradictory emails claiming my final statement is overdue. Please get it together âIonâ, and for anyone who wants to live here, the short commute is the only benefit you get.

langham-apartments-pcctsk.name: Langham Apartments

The public mini fridges on the first and second floor are almost always empty. The coffee machines are consistently out of product. The gym goes without clean towels and sanitary wipes, and has two non-functional peloton bikes. The outdoor fireplace is not functional. The golf simulator has a negligible amount of clubs, most of which are left handed. The lack of attention to amenities has been an ongoing issue for months, and it is hard to overlook these flaws when paying the monthly fee intended to maintain high quality amenities.

reviews.author: Regan Doughty
reviews.content: would rate 0 stars if I could. Booked tour of apartments, waited for 20 minutes for their representative to not show up. You cannot get a hold of a live human to talk to about anything. Waste of time.

reviews.author: Lancy
reviews.content:
Unfortunately, my experience with one of the front desk staff members was consistently disappointing. Her attitude remained unfriendly, impatient, and unprofessional. Every interaction with her made me feel unwelcome.

She often responded with a dismissive tone, lacked basic courtesy, and seemed unwilling to assist. Customer service should not depend on the situation or the guest, yet her attitude never improved throughout my time dealing with the front desk.

This is especially disappointing because The Langham has a reputation for excellent hospitality. A luxury property should ensure that every guest is treated with respect and professionalism. I sincerely hope management takes this feedback seriously and provides the necessary training to improve the guest experience.

langham-apartments-pcctsk.reviews_summary: This property generally offers a luxurious living experience with beautiful, modern apartments and an impressive array of amenities, including a pool, fitness center, movie theater, and golf simulator, making it a great place for students to socialize and relax. yugo-apex-college-station-3dd175db.name: Yugo Apex College Station
yugo-apex-college-station-3dd175db.property_summary: Yugo Apex College Station is located at 315 Boyett Street in College Station, providing accommodation for Texas A&M University students. This property provides residents with access to shared areas, recreational amenities, and essential facilities.

reviews.author: Lj Davis
reviews.content: I have lived here for over a year. This place gets more hate than it deserves, its not amazing but it has a great location to campus and northgate, decent amenities, and the apartment units aren't too bad (compared to nearby alternatives). The main issues that you would face living here: Getting your packages takes a while as the front desk has to organize them first and then notify you, The gym equipment often breaks because of the braindead freshman who decide to use the apartment gym as a playground, the pool is on the roof which is cool but usually is gross. Overall not bad for a college campus apartment. I would recommend living in a top floor, everything bad such as flooding and mold seems to happen to people who live near the first floor.

reviews.author: K MAC
reviews.content: All of these negative reviews are 100% accurate. The location and tour look great when you visit for the first time but the actual apartment you get is a joke. We are on our second year and it was a huge mistake. We will not be renewing. The new apartment was filthy when we moved in. We were told it was not their responsibility bc there was a renewal in the unit. That makes zero sense when we signed a new lease.  Multiple issues in the apartment that still havenât been fixed. Holes and gashes in walls in the unit and in the hallways. Staff is unresponsive and rude when you do get in touch w them. Highly recommend you live anywhere but here.

yugo-apex-college-station-3dd175db.reviews_summary: Students generally appreciate the convenient proximity to campus and Northgate, along with the decent amenities like the rooftop pool, which offers a nice view. However, some common frustrations include slow package delivery, frequent issues with gym equipment, and concerns about apartment upkeep and cleanliness, especially regarding initial move-in conditions and responsiveness to maintenance requests.

yugo-cincinnati-deacon-f6s3ae.name: Yugo Cincinnati Deacon
yugo-cincinnati-deacon-f6s3ae.property_summary: Located in the heart of Cincinnati, this student community offers a vibrant living experience with resort-style amenities, including a spacious outdoor pool and lounge area. Residents enjoy convenient proximity to campus with flexible pricing options ranging from $949 to $1,439 per month.

reviews.author: Sean Johnson
reviews.content: I wish there were a 0-star option. Cleaning supplies and trash were left in the unit before I moved in, and the AC wasn't working. There is mold growing in the building, the hallways smell like trash, and management is completely unresponsive. Gunshots were fired in the building, yet there was minimal communication regarding safety concerns. The parking garage door was damaged and left open for most of the lease term, leading to various break-ins throughout the garage. On top of that, $200 in charges were put on my account upon move-out, with zero response upon reaching out for further explanation. This is a money-hungry apartment; stay away at all costs.

Called to request the manager and was given the run around by a man that either really doesnât get it or is put in a bad position by management that hides behind their front desk. Awful start to the Deacon experience. Will certainly look for other housing next school year. Poor management!!! Absolute Awful!!!

reviews.author: Pillager
reviews.content: Just moved in here and the pool has been shut down the entire time. The water is genuinely green. I just wanna go swimming and theyâre saying itâs been closed since july??

yugo-cincinnati-deacon-f6s3ae.reviews_summary: While conveniently located near campus with some nice amenities, many students report significant issues with day-to-day living. Numerous reviews mention apartments being unclean or having maintenance problems upon move-in, including non-functional appliances, mold, and general disrepair, which often go unresolved despite repeated requests. A prevalent concern is the parking situation, with students frequently finding garages full despite paying for spots, compounded by security issues and unaddressed damage to garage doors. Overall, communication from management is consistently described as poor, leading to unaddressed concerns, unexpected fees, and a general lack of support for residents.
